scope: Eight grouped Node VM scenarios, including four malformed entry variants; not browser proof
checks: Four malformed-entry variants preserve static directory and keep filtering disabled
Duplicate identifiers reject the index without erasing fallback
Current index hydrates, folds accents/case and exposes no-match state
Valid empty index remains usable and distinct from failure
Cache age warning survives local filtering and is absent from network index
Retry deduplicates pending requests and restores search focus after recovery
Repeated failure keeps fallback and focuses the new retry control
